overall: No violation found: the July 16 meeting did not begin until a quorum was present and discussing business after the 11 A.M. posting. Robert's Rules allegation declined as outside the law. Caution issued only.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Council began its July 16 meeting before the posted 11 A.M. start time.
allegations.key_passage: Based on the available evidence, we find that a quorum of Council members only discussed Council business after 11 A.M.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that a quorum of the Council was not present when the July 16 meeting began.
allegations.key_passage: as the Council’s July 16 meeting did not start until after the posted meeting time, we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Council Chair does not follow Robert's Rules of Order.
allegations.key_passage: We note that, even if true, this allegation would not constitute a violation of G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25.
